en: A computer model's estimate guided by satellite haze readings, not a ground air monitor.
It misses local sources such as traffic, cooking fires and factories, so a city street can be much dirtier.
It leaves out nitrate, so it can read a little low.

en: A computer model's estimate from fire and fuel emissions, not a direct satellite reading.
It counts the gas through the whole air column, not the air you breathe at street level.
No satellite CO is fed into this model: it follows emission estimates, and satellite records show CO falling in many places where this rises.

ម៉ូដែលនេះមិនបានទទួលទិន្នន័យ CO ពីផ្កាយរណបទេ៖ វាដើរតាមការប៉ាន់ស្មានការបញ្ចេញ ហើយកំណត់ត្រាផ្កាយរណបបង្ហាញថា CO កំពុងថយចុះនៅកន្លែងជាច្រើន ដែលតួលេខនេះកើនឡើង។

notes: GES DISC on-prem OPeNDAP (goldsmr4) is retired (HTTP 410). merra2.py lists granules from CMR (cmr.earthdata.nasa.gov) and subsets each monthly granule through Earthdata Cloud OPeNDAP (opendap.earthdata.nasa.gov, dap4 .dap.nc4), so the existing merra2-aer-monthly record's via 'NASA Giovanni' no longer describes how pm25/dust/smoke are read; its docs16 row is updated above. Annual value = plain mean of the 12 monthly means on the native 0.5x0.625 grid, then bin1 mean to 1 deg; land and ocean kept; no year is missing a month. Keyword overlap with the existing 'aerosol' variable (pm2.5, smoke, dust storm(s), ការបំពុលខ្យល់, ធូលី, ផ្សែង): decide which variable owns them or the router will see ties. Buchard et al. 2016 evaluated the formula on MERRAero (MERRA v1 aerosol reanalysis); applying it to MERRA-2 is the standard GMAO practice. MERRA-2 has no nitrate, so pm25 reads low. co: MERRA-2 CO is an emissions-driven tracer, not assimilated (as far as I know; check GMAO docs). Its global land mean rises 0.564 to 0.639 g/m2 from 2001 to 2024, while satellite records (MOPITT) show CO falling. Consider doubt 'up' or an extra caveat. smoke: QFED counts the 2014 Holuhraun lava field in Iceland as fire, so that one cell reads ~208 ug/m3 in 2014. Other extremes are real fires: Yakutia 2021, Canada 2023 (~213). merra2.py imports bin1 and ownership from tools/build_catalog.py.
